evidence.original_label: Research and Development Activities, total expenses
evidence.excerpt: 6. Research and Development Activities To keep pace with increasingly sophisticated semiconductor manufacturing and laser processing technologies, the Group is conducting research and development in various advanced technology fields as well as products that will be the focus of the Group's business in the future. Led by technology divisions and the INNOMS Promotion Dept., the Group's research and development activities expenses for the current consolidated fiscal year have totaled 963 million yen.

notes: Holds-release packet (closes hold 2). Company-wide R&D expense for the fiscal year, from the 'Research and Development Activities' narrative item (the only precision TOWA discloses for R&D anywhere -- no finer table exists in any filing read). Cross-foot (the strongest confirmation available for these rows, since no table binds segment to year/column the way the profit note does): SME (JPY 885m) + Laser Processing Machine Business (JPY 78m, NOT independently registered -- Laser Processing is a non-equipment business line with no atlas equipment category to attach it to, and its own R&D is never disclosed under any category this atlas tracks) = JPY 963m, exactly equal to the disclosed total of JPY 963m. Medical Device R&D is not separately disclosed in any filing read for this packet; the exact two-way sum each year is the only evidence that nothing else is missing from the total.
